$comment: PROPOSED (CONTRACT CHANGE, window 17, task 2.2): the corrected `ProductFeed` component of packages/contracts/openapi/admin-api.yaml, kept here verbatim until the main window applies it. Admin API 0.3.0 defines ProductFeed as allOf[ProductFeedInput, {…}] where ProductFeedInput.status is [draft, active, paused] and the second branch's status is [draft, active, paused, error]. Under allOf a value must satisfy both branches, so a feed in `error` — the status publishFeed's own summary produces — is rejected by the document. Spelling the schema out instead of composing it fixes it without changing any field. Feed responses in `error` status are asserted against this file; every other feed response is asserted against the frozen document.
title: ProductFeed (proposed)
